tasks.title: Edit the live timeline

properties.name: A rejected command changes nothing
properties.expression: Rejected and an AudioCmd for the same command line
properties.formula: AG ¬atom("Rejected and an AudioCmd for the same command line")

properties.name: Timeline first, audio second
properties.expression: every AudioCmd follows the App's change to its own timeline for that command
properties.formula: AG atom("every AudioCmd follows the App's change to its own timeline for that command")

properties.name: Entry ids are stable
properties.expression: insert, delete, move and rotate never renumber an existing entry id; jumps name ids, not positions
properties.formula: AG atom("insert, delete, move and rotate never renumber an existing entry id; jumps name ids, not positions")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Performer
    participant App
    participant Audio
    Performer->>App: CommandLine
    alt choice 1
    App->>Audio: AudioCmd
    App->>Performer: Shown
    else alternative
    App->>Performer: Rejected
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> typing
    typing --> parsed: CommandLine
    parsed --> applied: AudioCmd
    applied --> shown: Shown
    parsed --> rejected: Rejected
    shown --> [*]
    rejected --> [*]

tasks.title: Play the timeline

properties.name: Jump passes
properties.expression: j X N passes the jump row N times: N-1 JumpTaken then one JumpExhausted that resets its counter; times 0 (always) never exhausts
properties.formula: AG atom("j X N passes the jump row N times: N-1 JumpTaken then one JumpExhausted that resets its counter; times 0 (always) never exhausts")

properties.name: Controls take no time
properties.expression: ControlApplied advances to the next row without a PhraseStart in between
properties.formula: AG atom("ControlApplied advances to the next row without a PhraseStart in between")

properties.name: Just intonation
properties.expression: every phrase frequency is root(snapped to the oud lattice) times a ratio p/q of its jins
properties.formula: AG atom("every phrase frequency is root(snapped to the oud lattice) times a ratio p/q of its jins")

properties.name: Every implementation logs the same protocol
properties.expression: with MAQAM_EVENT_LOG set, every message of protocol MaqamLive (spec/Maqam.leanfm) the app takes part in is appended to the event log once, in the order it happens, and the log conforms to MaqamLive (session_conform)
properties.formula: AG atom("with MAQAM_EVENT_LOG set, every message of protocol MaqamLive (spec/Maqam.leanfm) the app takes part in is appended to the event log once, in the order it happens, and the log conforms to MaqamLive (session_conform)")

properties.name: Every block is on time
properties.expression: in protocol AudioPeriod (spec/AudioPeriod.leanfm) every Pull reaches Played: block k of 64 frames at 48 kHz is released by the device at t0 + k * 64/48000 s and handed over before its release plus one period (1333.3 us); the wake-up delay counts as well as the rendering, every block counts (the maximum, never a percentile or an average), and an eventual Block after the period is not on time
properties.formula: AG atom("in protocol AudioPeriod (spec/AudioPeriod.leanfm) every Pull reaches Played: block k of 64 frames at 48 kHz is released by the device at t0 + k * 64/48000 s and handed over before its release plus one period (1333.3 us); the wake-up delay counts as well as the rendering, every block counts (the maximum, never a percentile or an average), and an eventual Block after the period is not on time")

properties.name: The reverb tail follows its decay
properties.expression: for an impulse into the reverb (markdown reverb) with decay d, T60 = 0.25 * 16^(d/0.98) s: the wet level (RMS over 50 ms) at 1.5 * T60 is at least 60 dB below its level 30..80 ms after the impulse, and at 0.5 * T60 it is less than 60 dB below it
properties.formula: AG atom("for an impulse into the reverb (markdown reverb) with decay d, T60 = 0.25 * 16^(d/0.98) s: the wet level (RMS over 50 ms) at 1.5 * T60 is at least 60 dB below its level 30..80 ms after the impulse, and at 0.5 * T60 it is less than 60 dB below it")

properties.name: The reverb is dense and wide
properties.expression: for the same impulse into both channels, every wet sample 100..200 ms after it is nonzero (no gaps between isolated echoes), and the left and right wet signals there correlate with |rho| < 0.3
properties.formula: AG atom("for the same impulse into both channels, every wet sample 100..200 ms after it is nonzero (no gaps between isolated echoes), and the left and right wet signals there correlate with |rho| < 0.3")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Audio
    participant App
    loop repeat
    alt choice 1
    Audio->>Audio: ControlApplied
    else alternative
    alt choice 1
    Audio->>Audio: JumpTaken
    else alternative
    Audio->>Audio: JumpExhausted
    end
    end
    end
    Audio->>Audio: PhraseStart
    Audio->>App: Position
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> at_row
    at_row --> playing: PhraseStart
    at_row --> at_row: ControlApplied
    at_row --> at_row: JumpTaken
    at_row --> at_row: JumpExhausted
    playing --> reported: Position
    reported --> [*]

tasks.title: Save and load a MAQAM_SESSION_V3 file

properties.name: Session round trip
properties.expression: load(save(timeline)) has the same entries, ids, sources and custom jins; the live settings (vol, per-bus vol, dry, tuneto) are never in the session, while vol, vol <bus> and dry timeline rows (L|, D|) are entries like any other
properties.formula: AG atom("load(save(timeline)) has the same entries, ids, sources and custom jins; the live settings (vol, per-bus vol, dry, tuneto) are never in the session, while vol, vol <bus> and dry timeline rows (L|, D|) are entries like any other")

sequenceDiagram

    alt choice 1
    App->>Audio: AudioCmd

tasks.title: Record cycles to an MP4

properties.name: Renders are deterministic
properties.expression: the offline render (--render) of one session, cycle count and sample rate writes the same samples on every run
properties.formula: AG atom("the offline render (--render) of one session, cycle count and sample rate writes the same samples on every run")

properties.name: A failed recording leaves no partial mp4
properties.expression: RecordFailed and a ./maqam-<secs>.mp4 or .partial.mp4 left by that render
properties.formula: AG ¬atom("RecordFailed and a ./maqam-<secs>.mp4 or .partial.mp4 left by that render")

tasks.title: Edit the score through an LLM

properties.name: LLM commands are checked before any is applied
properties.expression: Applied only when every returned command parses and is on the allowlist; otherwise none is applied
properties.formula: AG atom("Applied only when every returned command parses and is on the allowlist; otherwise none is applied")

properties.name: The LLM never saves, loads, records or plays
properties.expression: an LLM-returned save, load, m, q, z, pause, start, clockin, clockout, help, ls, audition, clear, vol or tuneto command applied
properties.formula: AG ¬atom("an LLM-returned save, load, m, q, z, pause, start, clockin, clockout, help, ls, audition, clear, vol or tuneto command applied")
